name: Animated Noise Field
description: Generates a colorful animated procedural noise field using multi-octave Perlin noise with FBM (Fractal Brownian Motion). Perfect for creating organic backgrounds, distortion maps, or displacement fields.
author: Rhizomium

usage.description: This preset creates a single ComputeNoise node that generates animated procedural noise. The noise evolves over time and can be used as a texture source, displacement field, or combined with other effects.
outputs: R, G, B, A - Individual color channels
tips: Increase 'octaves' for more detail (at performance cost)
Adjust 'scale' to change the frequency of the noise pattern
Disable 'colorize' for grayscale noise useful as displacement
